label: One optimized browser CPU diagnostic per frozen production slot; not an official timing batch
method: timeDeltas attributed to leaf (self) and ancestors (inclusive); recursive duplicate function/source identities counted once per sample; includes boot and idle
profileSpan: Profile starts before app iframe navigation and stops after unchanged runner resolves; includes boot and idle waits

adaptation.scope: Receipt field names and optimized slot names only; runner, CDP and workload operations unchanged

limitations: One profile per slot; sampling estimates identify investigation targets, not a precise attribution of the official median difference
Profiling includes boot and idle waits, unlike reset benchmark timing buckets
Diagnostic instrumented totals differ substantially from the official batch and are not comparable timing results
Inclusive times overlap across different ancestor functions/sources and must not be summed
Profiles cover the main-page CDP target including same-origin app iframe; native/browser work and unprofiled targets are not mapped to application functions
One fixed-order main-then-candidate pair shares a browser process with separate contexts; there is no repeated or randomized profile batch
